env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

! logos lint ./...
stderr 'b/b\.go:\d+:\d+: \[concurrency::lock_requirement_unmet\] badCall: call of \(\*a\.Tank\)\.Fill requires t\.Mu'
stderr 'b/b\.go:\d+:\d+: \[concurrency::lock_requirement_unmet\] wrongOrder: call of \(\*a\.Tank\)\.Fill requires t\.Mu'
! stderr 'guardOK'

-- go.mod --
module logostest

go 1.27

-- a/a.go --
package a

import "sync"

type Tank struct {
	Mu sync.Mutex

	//logos:guardedby Mu
	Level int
}

//logos:requires t.Mu
func (t *Tank) Fill() {
	t.Level = 100
}

//logos:acquires t.Mu
func (t *Tank) Seal() {
	_ = t.Level
}

-- b/b.go --
package b

import "logostest/a"

func badCall(t *a.Tank) {
	t.Fill()
}

func wrongOrder(t *a.Tank) {
	t.Fill()
	t.Mu.Lock()
	t.Fill()
	t.Mu.Unlock()
}

func guardOK(t *a.Tank) {
	t.Mu.Lock()
	defer t.Mu.Unlock()
	t.Fill()
}
